'''2007 Worlds Day 2 Warren Maruschak DS Agents Of Black Sun''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Warren Maruschak]] at [[2007 World Championship]] (Day 2).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Warren Maruschak]]
* '''Event:''' [[2007 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS13]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Agents Of Black Sun / Vengeance Of The Dark Prince|Ref2-D-agentsofblacksun.gif|label=Agents Of Black Sun}}
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
